lib/presenters/csv_report.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
module Presenters
  class CsvReport
    def self.render(pages)
      pages.pages.map { |page| "#{page.path},#{page.visits_count}" }.join("\n")
    end
  end
end

spec/tests/reviewer_feature_spec.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require_relative '../../lib/path_tracker/pages'
require_relative '../../lib/presenters/csv_report'
RSpec.describe 'CSV output' do
  it 'formats the page visit total' do
    pages = PathTracker::Pages.new
    pages.add_page('/home').add_visit('127.0.0.1')
    expect(Presenters::CsvReport.render(pages)).to eq('/home,1')
  end
end
